title: spergularia media subsp. angustata
intro: Spergularia media subsp. angustata, commonly known as Sandspurry, is a plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spergularia media subsp. angustata include reducing inflammation, fighting cancer cells, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
